projects.title: Complex network modelling using non-Shannonian entropies
projects.description: Pioneered the first ensemble model for complex networks using Tsallis entropy, discovering novel phenomena including phase transitions, degree correlations, and nontrivial clustering absent in traditional Shannon entropy approachesPreparing for publication

projects.title: AI Drill Classification Challenge
projects.description: Attended the AI Drill Classification Challenge organised at FNSPE CTU, aiming to classify acoustic emissions from a drilling experiment. Used combination of CNN, RNN and attention layers. Achieved 92,4% accuracy on the testing dataset

projects.title: Network reconstruction using the Scale invariant model
projects.description: Worked in the group of prof. Diego Garlaschelli, studying the applications of the so called Scale-Invariant network model in the problem of network reconstruction.Based on: Garuccio, E., Lalli, M., & Garlaschelli, D. (2023). Multiscale network renormalization: Scale-invariance without geometry. In Physical Review Research (Vol. 5, Issue 4). American Physical Society (APS).

projects.title: Dimensionality reduction using graphs
projects.description: Developed a novel dimensionality reduction algorithm which uses graphs as an intermediate representation. We were able to achieve reductions with comparable trustworthiness to state of the art algorithms. Our algorithm also managed to unroll the Swiss roll dataset.Used cgraph machine learning methods like graph embedding or GraphSAGE.

projects.title: Investigating multiple waves in epidemics
projects.description: Investigated properties of the SIRS epidemic model on different types of complex networks, showed that on one hand modular networks can increase the multiple-wave behaviour, on the other hand scale-free networks damp it.

projects.title: Creating educational videos for the Linear Algebra course
projects.description: Created a set of animated videos for the Linear Algebra course at FNSPE ČVUT, illustrating the key theorems in 2D and 3D. Used the manim library (3Blue1Brown)

projects.title: Identification of court decision topics
projects.description: Project on identifying appropriate methods for topic modelling in Czech language, on highly sofisticated texts of the Supreme Court decisions.

projects.title: Hanakroa.com website
projects.description: Designed and implemented a new website for Hana Kroa design studio.

projects.title: Organising competitions Pražská Střela and Dopplerova Vlna
projects.description: Designed new competition model for traditional competitions in maths and physics Pražská Střela and Dopplerova vlna. Then organised several seasons of this competition. During these years, the popularity of our competitions increased multiple times.

projects.title: Editor for WMMania.cz
projects.description: Wrote several articles for the website WMMania.cz, focusing on Windows Phone OS.
